steps.comment: The rule reads recipes rather than naming classes, so the only real check is against the loaded def database — an offline test cannot know that apparel recipes carry an unfinished thing. The step logs a full census of work-table defs and their verdicts. Absent DLC defs are skipped and reported, not failed.

args.comment_groupable: Benches with at least one shareable recipe. The last four are the interesting ones: mostly-unshareable crafting benches that the strict 'every recipe' form of this rule would have excluded, taking the whole crafting half of the game with them.
args.groupable: ElectricStove, FueledStove, TableStonecutter, ElectricSmelter, ButcherSpot, TableButcher, DrugLab, BiofuelRefinery, Brewery, Campfire, TableMachining, ElectricSmithy, FueledSmithy, ElectricTailoringBench
args.comment_notGroupable: Benches where every recipe would make a bill we cannot share, so a group could never hold anything. SubcoreEncoder is the one this rule fixes: its thingClass is a plain Building_WorkTable, so the old class whitelist let it in and would have put a Bill_Autonomous in a shared stack.
